candidate: JM1_FINAL = random player-minutes exposure + conditional dispersion refit + residual J2
NOT: not a joint team-minutes model: no exact 200/225-minute team reconciliation is claimed or performed
architect_authorization: 2026-10-19 ruling after the JM2 postmortem (JM2_POSTMORTEM.md, jm2_postmortem.json): JM2 rejected, no JM3; exactly one candidate, JM1_FINAL, the existing JM1 development arm frozen
pre_freeze_disclosure: JM1 was selected from 2024-25 DEVELOPMENT evidence (the diagnostic JM1 arm of the single frozen JointMinutesV2 run). The mechanism is the existing JM1 arm unchanged (verified by bit-level reproduction of saved development values). No parameter search. 2025-26 results of OTHER models were inspected earlier in the project (Phase 1B lockbox, Phase 2 J2 confirmation); no JM1 / JM1_FINAL 2025-26 result has been computed or seen. The run below is a LOCKED RETROSPECTIVE CONFIRMATION, not a pristine lockbox.

architecture.participation: Phase 1B P(play) unchanged; scored population = the Phase 2 population (PLAYED, eligible); all single-player quantities are conditional on playing, as in S0
architecture.exposure: per draw b and scored player i: M_ib = clip(min_mu_i + min_sigma_i eps_ib, 0, 60) x D_b / E[D]; eps_ib iid N(0,1) (independent across players: no team factor, no budget, no reservoir, no reconciliation, no teammate conservation); this is the Phase 1B discretized-normal conditional minutes marginal sampled directly
architecture.duration_environment: one duration D_b per game shared by both teams (fitted overtime law, D = 40 + 5K) and the accepted S1 shared game environment (pace / efficiency shocks), structural.simulate_state streams; pace never changes the clock
architecture.stat_means: log mu_ibs = log mu_1B,is + GLM(intercept, log(max(M_ib, 1) / min_mu_i), pace_dev, own_eff_dev, opp_eff_dev); anchor alpha = 1.0 (structural mean); ONE M_ib feeds all seven stats
architecture.counts: NB / Poisson mixture over draws with the refit conditional dispersion phi_s; count latents from the residual J2 Gaussian copula (common count-latent bank across arms)
architecture.combos: PRA / PR / PA / RA / STOCKS are sums of the same simulated stat draws

fitting_procedure.function: jm1_final.fit_procedure(T, resid_seasons) = phase3.build_procedure(T, resid_seasons, terms=JM_TERMS) + E[D] from the fitted overtime law
fitting_procedure.glm: Poisson pseudo-likelihood with offset log mu_1B on Phase 1B OOS rows 2022-23..T given the realized state
fitting_procedure.dispersion_refit: one phi per stat, method of moments on the true-OOS structural residual basis given realized minutes + environment (families kept)
fitting_procedure.residual_j2: dependence.fit(MID) on the conditional PMFs of the true-OOS structural residual basis
fitting_procedure.residual_basis: season F with structural parameters fitted through F-1 (true OOS)

confirmation.phase1b_forecasts: OOS store F2026 rows (training_through_season < forecast_season asserted)

chronology.final_refit_through_2025_26: NOT part of this protocol; only after a PASS and architect approval

comparison.population: every eligible scored player-game of every 2025-26 game in the Phase 1B OOS store with a pregame P(play) (phase3.season_inputs), S0 and JM1_FINAL on the SAME games / rows
comparison.pairing: same-game, common random numbers for count latents; game-clustered bootstrap
comparison.uncertainty: game-clustered bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 20366; 95% percentile intervals

joint: PRA / PR / PA / RA / STOCKS log / CRPS / threshold Brier
diagnostics: PTS latent spread ratio by role
both top scorers over (rate, Brier, log loss)

confirmation_gates_vs_S0.rule: strict: a gate passes only if its 95% bootstrap bound clears the margin; inconclusive = FAIL
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C1: aggregate MARG_LOG and aggregate MARG_CRPS_SCALED: upper bound < 0 (superiority)
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C2: every stat: MARG_LOG upper bound <= +0.002 and MARG_CRPS_SCALED upper bound <= +0.002
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C3: every stat x tier (TOP5_MINUTES, ROTATION_6_8, BENCH_9PLUS): MARG_LOG upper bound <= +0.005
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C4: every stat x position (G, F, C): MARG_LOG upper bound <= +0.005 (U reported only)
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C5: minutes exposure: MIN_CRPS upper bound <= +0.01 overall and <= +0.02 per tier vs Phase 1B
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C6: PTS latent spread ratio |log lam| closer to 1 than S0 for BENCH_9PLUS and ROTATION_6_8 (Phase 3 A4)
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C7: ES upper bound <= +0.003 and VS_BAL upper bound <= +0.0001, each bound >= 3 MC SE from its margin
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C8: both top scorers over (TM_SCORER_SCORER): Brier below S0 AND |observed - mean predicted| smaller (Phase 3 A6)
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.C9: 0 combo identity violations, 0 invalid correlation matrices, 0 genuine PIT violations, chronology asserted
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.decision: PASS iff every gate passes; otherwise FAIL (S0 stays champion; branch closed for 2026-27). No post-hoc rule, no repair loop, no rerun on a design failure.
confirmation_gates_vs_S0.gate_provenance: margins inherited unchanged from the frozen JointMinutesV2 protocol (G1/G2 minutes, G5 stat and stat x tier, G6 joint, G7 = Phase 3 A6) and Phase 3 A4; new: C1 superiority (a challenger must beat the champion) and C4 stat x position at the stat x tier margin. The gates were written after the 2024-25 development evidence was seen (development data); their development preview is recorded in the development evidence file.
